newsitem.title: USA: MBIA qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: MBIA qualifies 13 muni issues for bond insurance.

text.p: MBIA Insurance Corp. said Tuesday it qualified for bond insurance the following 13 municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Laguna Salada Unified School District, Calif., $3.3 million general obligation bonds.
--San Mateo County Transportation, Calif., $81,025 million limited tax and $63,680 million Transit limited tax bonds are a direct purchase.
--Frankenmuth, Mich., $2.615 million GOs and $2.6 million downtown development.
--Glencoe Independent School District, Minn., $2.255 million capital facilities GOs.
--Liverpool Central School District, N.Y., $5.056 million school bonds.
--Phoenix Central School District, N.Y., $2 million school district bonds.
--Anderson County School District, S.C., $1.6 million GOs.
